changed_layouts.name: FORM_BUSY
changed_layouts.observation: BUSYBEGIN tests and stores the main-form busy object; BUSYEND accesses and clears the same field. The form remains the incoming RCX object.

changed_layouts.name: PLFORM_PATS
changed_layouts.observation: MOVECHAN loads the form through mapped PLFORM global, reads the pattern-view object at this field, then tests its visible state and calls refresh helpers.

changed_layouts.name: PL_MARKSEL
changed_layouts.observation: MARKREFRESH remaps the selected marker index after iteration changes; FORMADDMARK selects the new marker for editing then resets this field to -1.

changed_layouts.name: PL_GRID
changed_layouts.observation: PLREFRESH loads this grid for refresh. Published VZoomSelectChange independently compares the selected grid to the playlist grid at this offset.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: CH_SELECTED
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: Published LinkMenuClick and AssignToFreeMixerTrackMenuClick resolve a channel then test its selected byte.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: CH_GRID
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: The channel refresh helper called by MOVECHAN reads each channel grid through this field and updates its UI state.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: PAT_STRIDE
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: NOTEARR and PATNAME index the pattern array by eight times three times eight.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: PAT_NOTES
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: NOTEARR tests, creates and returns the note-array object at pattern record plus 0x28.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: PAT_MARKERS
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: PATMARKS forms the marker-list address at pattern record plus 0x30.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: ED_TICKSPERPX
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: Published EEMarkerAddSongLoopMenuClick and EEMarkerAddSongLoop2MenuClick multiply the visible horizontal pixel position by the editor double at this field.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: ED_HSCROLL
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: The same marker handlers read horizontal scroll as a signed dword and convert it to double before the ticks-per-pixel multiplication.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: PR_GRID
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: PLREFRESH and published VZoomSelectChange read the piano grid at the unchanged form field.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: GRID_VSCROLL
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: Published VZoomSelectChange uses this grid field in scroll and zoom calculations for both editor branches.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: MIX_STRIDE
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: MUTE and MIXNAME index the mixer array by 0x51d times four; the MUTE loop independently increments by 0x1474.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: MIX_SLOTS_OFF
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: MIXNAME iterates effect object pointers at track plus 0x1324 plus slot times eight.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: MIX_ROUTE
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: SETROUTE indexes source track by 0x1474, then destination routes from 0x2e4 by eight-byte records and a flag at record plus four.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: PL_TRK_STRIDE
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: The name setter called by PLTRACK indexes playlist track records by 0x45 times four.

reviewed_unchanged_layouts.name: PL_TRK_NAME
reviewed_unchanged_layouts.observation: The playlist track name setter forms the string field at record plus 0x24.

abi_reviews.name: SETPROJ
observations: Preserves form RCX, path RDX, second path R8 and byte addRecent R9B; same 0x4460 stack frame.
Assigns UnicodeString path globals 0x1581298/0x15812a0 through the same helper 0x4133f0. Independent caller and function-order matches agree.

abi_reviews.name: SAVEPROJ
observations: Preserves path RCX and byte flags DL with the same 0x98 stack frame.

Both versions jump to a protector thunk after the prologue. Linear decode after that jump includes junk; normalized whole-function similarity is not a full-body review or evidence of a changed incoming ABI.

abi_reviews.name: SETROUTE
observations: Preserves object RCX, source EDX, destination R8D, enable R9D and the fifth stack-byte argument. Mixer layout corroborated in the route access.

abi_reviews.name: MSGBOX
observations: Seven-instruction wrapper preserves RCX/RDX, moves R8 callback into R9, sets R8D from AL=3, and calls the mapped core at 0xa8877c. Existing mode-one prefix is compatible.

tooling_candidates.name: FORMADDMARK
tooling_candidates.observation: Unique level-one 27-byte signature. Body preserves form, position, name and action arguments plus two stack-byte time-signature arguments; forwards to the marker-list routine.

tooling_candidates.name: PL_MARKERS
tooling_candidates.observation: FORMADDMARK uses the form marker list at this offset. Its record stride is 0xd times four (0x34); adjacent selected-index field at 0xd64 is independently confirmed.

limitations: This evidence does not execute FL Studio and does not establish end-to-end compatibility. Runtime project load/save, all pattern operations, channel reorder, notes, markers, mixer routing/effects, editor state, and asset transfer require separate tests.
Offset histograms combine unrelated object types and are candidate evidence only; only the explicitly contextualized fields above have been reviewed by object use.
Protected function bodies are not exhaustively decoded. SAVEPROJ review covers the incoming ABI and mapping evidence; runtime save behavior must be checked separately.
This is an integration-specific review, not a claim to have reverse engineered every FL Studio subsystem.
